data.title: 中野一花 · 晨曦微光中的初醒凝视
data.description: 清晨第一缕纯净阳光透过白纱窗帘斜照在凌乱的大床上。一花刚刚从睡梦中醒来，微卷的粉发蓬松地散在枕边。她侧卧在雪白的羽绒被间，睡眼惺忪地揉着眼角，看到身边的少年时，嘴角自然而然地泛起慵懒甜蜜的微笑。
data.action: lying in white bed, rubbing eye, drowsy warm smile
data.lighting: soft golden morning sunlight filtering through sheer curtains
data.promptProse: Lying lazily in a soft white bed bathed in gentle morning sunshine, Nakano Ichika slowly wakes up in her pink silk negligee. Her messy pink hair frames her face as she rubs her sleepy eyes and smiles warmly up at the viewer.
data.animaCaption: Ichika waking up gently in bed under morning sunlight.
